purpose: Single source of truth for the container images the lakehouse tile bake runs (root ADR-0112 §9). External images are pinned by digest; the tippecanoe image is built from infra/tiles/tippecanoe/Dockerfile, which pins its base digest and source commit.

gdal.reason: ubuntu-small carries GEOS, which -makevalid needs; alpine-small does not.

tippecanoe.reason: No official image or binary release exists, so it is built from the tagged source commit.
